_readme: Per-app JS budgets, gzip KB (TASK-031). Seeded from the current build plus a small margin so the gate is meaningful immediately; TASK-022 tightens initial budgets to the architecture targets (storefront ≤ 100, admin ≤ 250) and becomes blocking there. `initialKb` counts SvelteKit entry+chunks; SPA builds have no initial convention yet, so their initial is reported but not enforced, and the per-route `routeKb` carries the budget. The SPA per-chunk `chunkKb` still caps every non-route chunk.
